selection_rule: Rule B2: highest mean validation F1 across 5 seeds, among contamination settings of at most 5%, a constraint taken from Section 1.5 of the paper, which describes the output as a review queue
fitted_on: in-scope rows of the train split only
risk_boundary_note: Two levels. The boundary is the 33.3rd percentile of the in-scope training flagged scores, unchanged from the boundary previously used for the High level. The former Medium and Low levels were merged because testing on validation and test data showed they do not differ (Fisher exact p = 0.69 on test).
